notes: v1.14.559 — THE TENTH TOOL, AND THE NAME COLLISION. IA-SHIFTNAV Ship 1 (owner rulings V-1 and 1a, tap trade accepted, OPTIC LEDGER approved). ⛔ SCOPE CORRECTED BY MEASUREMENT BEFORE ANY EDIT: Phase 1 wrote Ship 1 as 'the ten OPS tools gain a findable entry point', but .558 had already delivered that for NINE of them — the restored OPS row sits at top 94px, h 44px, on screen with zero scrolling one tap from launch, and two taps produced nine panels with the deepest at 0px. Re-shipping that would have been churn. ⭐ WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINED: ISOLATE was in DEPLOY_TOOLS (:32176) and in the Command Deck row but NOT in OPS_PANELS_CONFIG, so it was the one tool the accepted tap trade never paid off for — still one tap plus 2.9 screens of blind scrolling while its nine siblings were two taps away. It now joins the row, with the icon and accent taken from DEPLOY_TOOLS' own registry rather than invented, in registry order so the row and the registry read the same. Its statistic reports OPEN ISOLATION SESSIONS, and the branch is written out rather than defaulted because of Contract B10: '0' means no open isolations, a measurement, while '—' means not measured, and a panel that renders the second as the first is fabricating telemetry. ⭐ THE COLLISION: two surfaces answered to the word OPTICS — this deployment-scoped scanner/inventory, and the fiber/MPO REFERENCE in Tools. The Phase 0 census found a tester told to 'find the optics tool' would reach the reference, see something plausibly optic-shaped, and believe they had succeeded. The deployment tool is now OPTIC LEDGER in three label sites; the reference keeps OPTICS, which is the entire point of the split. ⛔ ONLY LABELS MOVED: the tab key stays 'optics', OPS_TABS keeps its 'optics' key, and the single live rd_openOpsTool('optics') call is untouched — renaming the identifier would have broken every door at once. ⚠ The buried #cs-fieldtools row is deliberately LEFT (ruling D-1 default): both entry points call the one canonical rd_openOpsTool, so it is one door with two handles, and removing it would break 03-tools' order-sensitive wall assertion and strip the desktop composition's only tool access at ≥1024. Pinned by 48-ops-row-exists, now asserting ten panels including ISOLATE and the OPTIC LEDGER label.
